Name: Claroty xDome CCF
Author: Claroty xDome CCF Maintainers
Description: The Claroty xDome CCF solution ingests Claroty xDome data into Microsoft Sentinel using the Codeless Connector Framework (CCF) pull pattern - polling the xDome public API directly, with no agent, collector VM, or syslog forwarder required. A single API-polling data connector ingests seven data types into dedicated tables: Alerts, Device-Alert relations, OT Activity Events, Vulnerabilities, Device-Vulnerability relations, Device inventory, and Audit Log. Each data type supports an optional filter to control ingested volume. Connect once with your xDome API root URL and a Bearer API token.
WorkbookDescription: Operational dashboard for Claroty xDome covering alerts, device inventory, vulnerabilities, OT activity, and audit events. Built entirely on the solution's ASIM parsers and workspace functions (no direct _CL queries).
WorkbookBladeDescription: This solution installs a workbook for Claroty xDome. After installing the solution, the workbook can be managed from the Manage solution view.
AnalyticalRuleBladeDescription: This solution installs analytic rule templates for Claroty xDome. After installing the solution, create and enable analytic rules from the Manage solution view.
HuntingQueryBladeDescription: This solution installs hunting queries for Claroty xDome. After installing the solution, run these hunting queries to hunt for threats from the Manage solution view.
